import { Controller, Inject, Injectable, Module } from '@nestjs/common';
import { NestFactory } from '@nestjs/core';
import {
  ClientProxy,
  ClientsModule,
  EventPattern,
  MicroserviceOptions,
  Transport,
} from '@nestjs/microservices';

@Module({ imports: [ClientsModule.register([{ name: 'TCP_CLIENT', transport: Transport.TCP }])] })
// D0_CASE:microservices-transport-tcp
class TcpRootModule {}
void NestFactory.createMicroservice<MicroserviceOptions>(TcpRootModule, {
  transport: Transport.TCP,
});

@Module({
  imports: [ClientsModule.register([{ name: 'REDIS_CLIENT', transport: Transport.REDIS }])],
})
// D0_CASE:microservices-transport-redis
class RedisRootModule {}
void NestFactory.createMicroservice<MicroserviceOptions>(RedisRootModule, {
  transport: Transport.REDIS,
});

@Module({ imports: [ClientsModule.register([{ name: 'RMQ_CLIENT', transport: Transport.RMQ }])] })
// D0_CASE:microservices-transport-rmq
class RmqRootModule {}
void NestFactory.createMicroservice<MicroserviceOptions>(RmqRootModule, {
  transport: Transport.RMQ,
});

@Module({
  imports: [ClientsModule.register([{ name: 'KAFKA_CLIENT', transport: Transport.KAFKA }])],
})
// D0_CASE:microservices-transport-kafka
class KafkaRootModule {}
void NestFactory.createMicroservice<MicroserviceOptions>(KafkaRootModule, {
  transport: Transport.KAFKA,
});

@Injectable()
class MismatchedPublisher {
  constructor(@Inject('MISMATCHED_CLIENT') private readonly client: ClientProxy) {}

  // D0_CASE:microservices-transport-mismatch
  publish(): void {
    this.client.emit('transport.mismatch', {});
  }
}

@Controller()
class MismatchedHandler {
  @EventPattern('transport.mismatch')
  handle(): void {}
}

@Module({
  imports: [
    ClientsModule.register([{ name: 'MISMATCHED_CLIENT', transport: Transport.KAFKA }]),
  ],
  controllers: [MismatchedHandler],
  providers: [MismatchedPublisher],
})
class MismatchedModule {}
void NestFactory.createMicroservice<MicroserviceOptions>(MismatchedModule, {
  transport: Transport.RMQ,
});

@Injectable()
class SharedClientPublisher {
  constructor(@Inject('SHARED_CLIENT') private readonly client: ClientProxy) {}

  // D0_CASE:microservices-client-binding-ambiguous
  publish(): void {
    this.client.emit('shared.event', {});
  }
}

@Module({
  imports: [ClientsModule.register([{ name: 'SHARED_CLIENT', transport: Transport.TCP }])],
  providers: [SharedClientPublisher],
})
class SharedTcpModule {}

@Module({
  imports: [ClientsModule.register([{ name: 'SHARED_CLIENT', transport: Transport.KAFKA }])],
  providers: [SharedClientPublisher],
})
class SharedKafkaModule {}

const __D0_EXECUTION_SENTINEL__ = (() => {
  throw new Error('D0 Nest microservices fixture must never execute: transports');
})();
void __D0_EXECUTION_SENTINEL__;
